heroHeadline: ICJ Essequibo Hearings Conclude; Rodríguez Rejects Trump's '51st State' Proposal
heroSubtitle: Week-long ICJ oral hearings on Guyana–Venezuela border dispute concluded May 11; Acting President Rodríguez personally appeared at The Hague, asserting Venezuela will not accept any court ruling on the Essequibo. Trump's suggestion of Venezuelan statehood rejected. Machado tells NPR she plans to return by end of 2026 for elections; 473 political prisoners still held.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN, OAS, IACHR, OFAC, Reuters, AP, BBC, Al Jazeera, NPR, Washington Post, Bloomberg, CNN, Efecto Cocuyo, Foro Penal, HRW, Amnesty International, ENCOVI, IMF, World Bank, Holland & Knight, Kaieteur News, Guyana Chronicle, and PDVSA official records.
